1.consolidated_definition: Pasar hambre o necesidades. También estar en la yuca, guayar yuca.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To experience hunger or need; to be in a state of poverty or lack, often colloquially referred to as "estar en la yuca" (to be in the cassava), an idiomatic expression that alludes to being impoverished and struggling to make ends meet.
